dialogues.speaker: Popocani
dialogues.text: That's the name of this island we're on.

dialogues.speaker: Popocani
dialogues.text: In the local language, it translates to "cavern of stone and prickly pears."

dialogues.speaker: Popocani
dialogues.text: But, yeah... Prickly pears don't grow here anymore — Nochtli and Nanas both... Maybe it's because the nutrients in the soil aren't what they used to be.
